348:t_022:14.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$アサキム$$... I'll put our final showdown on hold for now.」

348:t_022:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...This is the height of stupidity. You really are an inferior species.」

348:t_022:16.en:
$$万丈$$
「Here I come, $$サイデリアル$$! I swear I'll win here on $$火星$$!」

348:t_023:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Tch... I couldn't finish him off.」

348:t_023:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Are you running away, $$バルビエル$$!?」

348:t_023:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm not stupid enough to fight six $$スフィア$$s at once.」

348:t_024:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Tch... What a bothersome bunch.」

348:t_024:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Are you running away, $$バルビエル$$!?」

348:t_024:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm not stupid enough to fight six $$スフィア$$s at once.」

348:t_026:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Don't pursue him, $$アサキム$$. We need not rush to settle this here.」

348:t_027:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wait, $$アサキム$$. I have questions for you.」

348:t_027:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have no further business here.」

348:t_027:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You really didn't like being sealed inside $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, did you?」

348:t_027:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...Not really. I thought sleeping forever would be best for both me and you.」

348:t_027:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But if I've been woken, I'll struggle on. Uglily, miserably... and disgracefully.」

348:t_028:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...He does tend to be rather single-minded.」

348:t_028:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... Did you free $$アサキム$$ from $$ＺＯＮＥ$$?」

348:t_028:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No. But circumstances brought us together, and we began traveling together.」

348:t_028:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Did you bring him into the $$クロノ$$ Reformists?」

348:t_028:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You may think of it that way.」

348:t_028:6.en:
$$桂$$
「You were supposed to have died fighting $$ガドライト#pilot$$...」

348:t_028:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Are you unhappy that I'm alive?」

348:t_028:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's not what we mean, but...」

348:t_028:9.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We've fought someone who pretended to be dead before.」

348:t_028:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$偽りの黒羊$$, $$アイム・ライアード$$... Yes, my survival is probably similar to the power of his $$スフィア$$.」

348:t_028:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No, Miss $$スズネ$$. I always speak only the truth.」

348:t_028:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n... You know that, too, don't you?」

348:t_028:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I apologize for not telling you I survived. ...But you will trust me, won't you?」

348:t_028:17.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Look into my eyes, $n.」

348:t_028:19.en:
$n
「Because above all, I'm glad you're alive...」

348:t_029:0.en:
$$ブルー$$
「...I'm sorry, Captain. We lost sight of $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

348:t_029:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's all right, $$ブルー$$. He and I are heading to the same destination, so he'll return to us eventually.」

348:t_029:3.en:
$$ブルー$$
「It's been a while, $$クロウ$$. I heard you went to $$蒼の地球$$, but you've joined $c, I see.」

348:t_029:4.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Did you know $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was alive?」

348:t_029:5.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I'm sorry. When we contacted you, we still didn't know that ourselves.」

348:t_029:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You appeared in $$第２新東京市$$ when we nearly got caught in $$アマルガム$$'s $$時空震動$$ bomb...」

348:t_029:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That was on my orders. I tried to suppress the $$時空震動$$, but you know the result.」

348:t_029:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I am sorry about that.」

348:t_029:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Wait, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. We haven't finished talking.」

348:t_029:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'm sorry, $$クロウ$$. I still have things I must do.」

348:t_029:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But someday I will fight alongside you, because we are heading to the same destination.」

348:t_029:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We will meet again, $n. I await the day you surpass hope and despair.」

348:t_030:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Everything is shrouded in mystery, including the existence of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists...」

348:t_030:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You can tell me to trust a man like that, but...」

348:t_030:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Stop it, $$クルツ$$. Think about how $n feels.」

348:t_030:5.en:
$n
「No, it's all right... I haven't quite come to terms with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ being alive myself...」

348:t_030:6.en:
$n
「Of course, I'm glad he's alive, but...」

348:t_030:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Everyone... Forgive the interruption, but a fleet is approaching us.」

348:t_031:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$クォーター$$...! And the $$ラー・カイラム$$ and other ships, too!」

348:t_031:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's not all! The $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ is here, too!」

348:t_031:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ブルー$$ guided us here, and we find...」

348:t_031:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I never expected to find them here, too...」

348:t_031:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Have they been tossed about by a great power, just as we were...?」

348:t_031:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...The $$アークセイバー$$s have contacted us. They report that the $$マリーメイア$$ Army remnants have been wiped out.」

348:t_031:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's a relief... The colonists on $$火星$$ are safe, then.」

348:t_031:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Let's join up with them first and exchange information.」

348:t_031:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...The fates of those bearing the $$烙印$$ are tossed about by $$時空震動$$s... is that it...?」

348:t_031:10.en:
$$万丈$$
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... And the $$クロノ$$ Reformists...)

348:t_032:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You're an irritating bastard! At least act a little worried!」

348:t_032:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Are you saying you have complete control over your emotions...!?」

348:t_032:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's absurd. Do you scream that you're dying just because you trip over a stone on the road?」

348:t_032:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's all you amount to! Before me and $$アン・アーレス$$, anyway!」

348:t_032:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't get cocky, $$バルビエル$$! Then I'll use that stone to smash your skull open!」
